incident-bot: ALERT: P0 - downstream inference error rate spike (service: redwood-runtime)
incident-bot: Pager sent to oncall rotation (priority: page)
Priya (oncall): copying thread here — getting paged during handoff, fyi. current status: error rate ~12% over 5m, 90th latency up. No customer page yet but could surface.
Alex (incoming): I’m on my way in — ETA ~7m. Priya, do you want me to take driver or do you want to hand off comms?
Priya (oncall): If you can take driver that’d be great. I’ll stay comms until handoff completes. Need to make sure secondary is assigned.
Maria (sre): I can be secondary/diagnostics. I’ll look at downstream workers and KV cache metrics.
Kelly (backend): I’m available for code-level debugging but can’t jump fully until 15m.
Priya (oncall): Ok plan: Alex = driver, Maria = secondary, Priya = comms owner until Alex confirms takeover. Kelly = escalation for backend. Jon, keep paging escalation ready.
Jon (pager): noted. If we need DB SME I’ll page DB-oncall (use escalation channel).
Alex (incoming): Taking driver. Locking the incident doc and updating ownership now.
Priya (oncall): Updated incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0423 (notes + timeline). We’re marking customer impact: degraded generation quality for ~10% of requests, latency spikes causing timeouts for long-context jobs.
Maria (sre): Quick checks I ran:
```
# tail of runtime logs showing failure mode
grep "kv_cache_miss" /var/log/redwood/runtime.log | tail -n 40
# cpu/gpu usage: ok, but memory on worker-23 elevated
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv
```
Maria (sre): Observed repeated `kv_cache_shard_timeout` on worker-23. Could be network flakiness between workers.
Priya (oncall): Runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/kv-cache#network-issues — follow step 2 (isolate worker) then 3 (restart worker).
Alex (driver): On it. I’ll isolate worker-23 from rotation and bounce the runtime process there. Doing `curl` to drain: `POST /nodes/worker-23/drain`
Alex (driver): Draining now — `200 OK`. Removing from router pool.
Kelly (backend): If drain works, we should ensure requests route to fallback model variant to reduce cold-start overhead. Suggest enabling `fallback: cheap-variant` policy in routing config.
Alex (driver): Applied temporary route fallback via admin UI.
incident-bot: NOTE: Canaries enabled, routing fallback applied by Alex (incoming).
Maria (sre): Restarting runtime on worker-23: `systemctl restart redwood-runtime`
Maria (sre): Runtime restarted, healthcheck passing. Observing error-rate dropping to ~3% over 2m.
Priya (oncall): Update posted to incident doc and #customers-impacted per runbook. No pager to customers yet; CS notified as FYI.
Jon (pager): If errors stay <5% for 5m we can remove P0 pager and mark mitigated.
Priya (oncall): Small gap to note — DB SME not on shift until +1h. We may need DB-team on-call if errors reappear and point to DB queries. Flagged in incident doc.
Alex (driver): Confirmed mitigation holding. I’ll stay as driver for next 10m while I finish post-mortem notes and handover.
Maria (sre): I’ll run additional KV cache integrity check: `python tools/kv_check.py --target worker-23` and post results.
Maria (sre): KV check looks good; no corruption. Looks like transient network hiccup.
Priya (oncall): Hand off timeline: I’m going to sign out in 12m. Alex, please confirm you accept full ownership (driver + follow-up) and Maria will remain secondary for postmortem.
Alex (incoming): I accept ownership for the rest of the incident and postmortem. I’ll create follow-up ticket for monitoring alert thresholds and router fallback automation.
Priya (oncall): Thanks — I’m handing comms to Alex now. Alex, please post an update to `#eng-status` and set the incident to `Mitigated` once stability windows pass.
Alex (driver): Posted update to #eng-status with summary and mitigation steps. Setting incident state to `Investigating -> Stabilized`.
Priya (oncall): Signing out — if anything spikes, page Alex (pager) first. Good handoff. :raised_hands:
Alex (incoming): Acknowledged. I’ll keep this thread live and update `last_message_ts` when we close.
incident-bot: ACTION: Ownership change recorded: driver=Alex (incoming), comms=Alex (incoming), secondary=Maria (sre).
DB-team-bot: FYI — DB-oncall will be paged if DB errors escalate.
Priya (oncall): Closing handoff notes here. Thanks team.
Alex (driver): Final note: created follow-up ticket RED-OPS-872 (increase kv cache network timeouts, add runbook automation).
Maria (sre): Added postmortem stub.
Jon (pager): monitoring hook added to alert on `kv_cache_shard_timeout` frequency.
Alex (driver): Last update for thread — metrics stable for 12m, error rate ~1.2%. I’m locking incident to `Monitoring` for 1h then will close if stable.
_meta: generated by dataset-gen: on-call handoff during active incident
